note: Wikimedia Commons, “Жития Святых (1903-1911) - икона 03092 Феоктиста.png”; artist as recorded there: Unknown author — fetched 14 October 2026 at 605px. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: A Russian Menaion Reader plate with both halves of the identity rule. The code «03092» reads church-month 03 = November, day 09, and 9 November is this folder's feast in all four calendars. The title «Феоктиста» is the forename of the folder's own stored Russian form, «Феоктиста Паросская», and Commons files the plate under `Category:Theoktiste of Lesbos` — the two epithets are the same saint, the Lesbian who lived as a hermit on Paros, which is why this folder stores «Паросская» in Russian and «of Lesbos» as its display name. Reached by route 2: Wikidata Q7781549 «Теоктиса Пароска», the folder's own stored Serbian form, carries this plate as its P18. A single-figure plate, 605x1739. Commons describes it: Иллюстрации к книге: Жития святых на русском языке, изложенные по руководству Четьих-Миней  с дополнениями, объяснительными примечаниями и изображениями святых
